title: minuartia peploides subsp. major
intro: Minuartia peploides subsp. major, commonly known as alpine pearlwort or greater pearlwort, is a plant species in the carnation family (Caryophyllaceae). It is a perennial herb that grows in mountainous regions and has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits. The plant has been reported to possess anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which may contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as wound healing and pain relief. Bioactive constituents of Minuartia peploides subsp. major include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, although more research is needed to fully understand the plant's effects on human health.
